fields.description: Issue includes editorials and reporting opposing a proposed Florida sales tax and urging public voting via printed coupons; coverage of Miami Beach city management and allegations of protection of a gambling syndicate involving City Manager Claude Renshaw; an exposé alleging misconduct and prior embezzlement charges involving Dr. Earl Moore; local court and policing columns describing arrests and alleged retaliatory enforcement; real estate and civic commentary (business rents, sidewalks, home ownership); Miami Beach development news on remaining oceanfront hotel sites; and a medical column on birthmarks.
